versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 13 -> 15 concepts. Added 2 (new or reclassified descendants in the new release): Extended spectrum beta-lactamase producing Klebsiella pneumoniae subspecies ozaenae (37464355); Carbapenemase-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae subsp. ozaenae (37464356). 2 concept names updated by the vocabulary (e.g. 'Multiple drug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae subsp. ozaenae' -> 'Multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae subsp. ozaenae').
